description: This file defines the HtmlMenuWrapper class, which facilitates the setup and rendering of HTML menus within a web application. It manages menu model retrieval, rendering, context management, and interaction with HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapper
classes.description: A utility class that simplifies the initialization, rendering, and context management for HTML menus in a web application.

methods.name: HtmlMenuWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with resource name, menu name, request, and response, invoking setup procedures.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the menu wrapper with provided resource and menu names, and HTTP request/response objects. Loads menu model and renderer, and sets up context including user info, parameters, and error states.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns an instance of the menu renderer used for rendering the menu.

methods.name: renderMenuString
methods.description: Generates the menu HTML as a string by delegating to the model's render method.

methods.name: setIsError
methods.description: Sets the error state in the context to influence rendering behavior.

methods.name: getIsError
methods.description: Retrieves the current error state from the context.

methods.name: setMenuOverrideName
methods.description: Overrides the menu name in the rendering context.

methods.name: putInContext
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the internal context map.

methods.name: putInContext (overload)
methods.description: Adds a nested map entry for a specific menu item.

methods.name: getFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the context by key.

methods.name: getFromContext (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value associated with a menu item and value key.

methods.name: getModelMenu
methods.description: Returns the model representation of the menu.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Returns the current menu renderer instance.

methods.name: setRenderer
methods.description: Sets the menu renderer instance.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Updates the HTTP request object and sets it within the renderer.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Updates the HTTP response object and sets it within the renderer.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object used by the renderer.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP response object used by the renderer.

methods.name: getMenuWrapper
methods.description: Static factory method to retrieve or create a menu wrapper instance from session or context, supporting dynamic class loading.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Updates the parameters in the rendering context.
